notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.content: [p]Welcome to our very first DevBlog! 🎉[/p][p]We’re excited to finally share what’s been happening behind the scenes in the shark lab. From core mini-games to story progress, here’s a peek at what we’ve been working on this week.[/p][p][/p][h2]Development Progress[/h2][p] [/p][p]🦷 [b]Tooth Drilling[/b][/p][p]This week we’ve been focusing on the core mini-games, starting with tooth drilling. Technically, this has been quite a challenge. Our goal is to strike a balance between performance and realism so the process feels tactile and satisfying without causing lag.[/p][p]💦 [b]Spray Mechanic[/b][/p][p]We’ve also introduced a new spray mechanic. Tools now appear in the player’s hand instead of simply vanishing from the table. It’s a small detail, but it greatly improves immersion — you actually feel like you’re holding the equipment. The drill and other instruments will soon follow the same logic.[/p][p]💉 [b]Interactive Lab Objects[/b][/p][p]Progress continues on interactive elements within the lab. Lighting can now be toggled individually via switches. It’s a small but impactful detail that makes the environment feel more alive and will play into gameplay.[/p][p]🔌 [b]High-Density Tooth Models[/b][/p][p]Our artists are working on new high-density tooth models. These allow us to represent cavities and their gradual removal more realistically. Damage will no longer look like a simple stain — it will appear as a true change to the tooth’s surface. Players will need to drill carefully to avoid hitting the nerve, or risk a painful mistake and defeat.[/p][p]📖 [b]Story Progress[/b][/p][p]Finally, the narrative side of the project is moving forward. We’re assembling cutscenes, including some dramatic moments, to highlight that not everything in this game is harmless — after all, shark teeth can bite back.[/p][p][/p][h2]Community[/h2][p][/p][p]Visit our socials to stay in touch, learn more about the game and discuss the game![/p][p][/p][p]💬 [b]Discord:[/b] [url="https://discord.gg/rbfxhqx95V"]https://discord.gg/rbfxhqx95V[/url][/p][p]🐦 [b]Twitter/X:[/b] [url="https://x.com/dentist_shark"]https://x.com/dentist_shark[/url][/p][p][/p][p]See you at the shark lab! [img src="https://a.slack-edge.com/production-standard-emoji-assets/14.0/google-medium/1f988.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Shark Dentist Playtest Applications Now Open!
notes.content:
[p]We’re excited to announce that you can now [b]apply to join the Shark Dentist playtest![/b] The game is still in development, and we’re working hard to make it a thrilling and unique experience.
[/p][p]🦈 Playtest will take place late 2025 – early 2026 — mark your calendars!
[/p][p]Anyone interested can apply, but please note there [b]may be a player limit[/b], so participants will be selected randomly.
[/p][p]Shark Dentist is a tense horror roguelike where you perform risky dental procedures on giant, deadly sharks. Balance your tools, manage the shark’s stress, and survive the unexpected in a dark, intense atmosphere.
[/p][p]Stay up to date with all the latest news, sneak peeks, and behind-the-scenes content by joining our community!
[/p][p]🦷 Join our Discord: [url="https://discord.com/invite/5MPPJqegEx"]https://discord.com/invite/5MPPJqegEx[/url][/p][p]🦷 Follow us on Twitter\\X: [url="https://x.com/dentist_shark"]https://x.com/dentist_shark[/url][/p][p]
We can’t wait to see you in the clinic![/p]

notes.title: Shark Dentist looks a bit silly, tense, gruesome and I need to play it
notes.content:

notes.title: Shark Dentist is a 'horror roguelike' that's basically The Meg mashed up with an early '90s Milton Bradley toy
notes.content: Shark Dentist. The words glared at me from my inbox. Shark Dentist. Chris Livingston brought them to the PC Gamer Slack channel, his curiosity fervent. Shark Dentist. Somewhere in the distance, a secretary began pounding her clipboard. Shark Dentist... Read more.

notes.title: New horror game Shark Dentist is exactly what it says it is, and it's terrifying
notes.content:
I've never been a fan of going to the dentist, but I'm pretty sure the creepy horror sim, Shark Dentist, is about to put me off going for life. Inspired by Buckshot Roulette but with sharks, because of course, this pulse-pounding horror game puts you in the gloves of a dentist in charge of patients with chompers that rival Jaws himself. Shudder.
